rulings.why: The page tells these changes from the row (`can`), or the judge could not tell (`unclear`), but no check of the shape readings does: movedown:1.4: can: p199-strip800.jpg systems 2 and 3, stanza 1's row: "Thee" (a name of God) and the place name after it both carry capitals anyway, but the header on p199-strip0.jpg prints 8.7.8.7.D., which gives line 4 seven syllables and line 5 eight. The change makes them 6 and 9.
